Cypriot meze in Paphos

What guests mention

What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Cypriot meze

269 Google reviews mention the meze, 64 Cypriot food, 16 the stifado and 14 the moussaka. One guest writes that it combines authentic Cypriot favourites with carefully selected international dishes.

Vegan and gluten free

154 reviews mention the vegan options, 69 the vegan meze and 21 the gluten free options. One guest writes that the waiter pointed out an appetiser of rice and green lentils as gluten free.

A family run restaurant

36 reviews mention that it is family run. The restaurant's Instagram profile describes it as a family run restaurant since 1977.

From the restaurant

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Small touches

One guest writes about a starter on the house and a small dessert at the end. Another writes that the kids' main meal came out with the adult starters and a complimentary drink followed at the end.

A table on the terrace

One guest writes that they came without a reservation, the inside was full, and they were accommodated on the terrace outside.

Generous portions, friendly staff

One guest writes that they went back for a second meal and calls the meatballs and the kleftiko amazing.

What guests say

Three of 1,431 Google reviews, 1,202 of them with five stars.

“Excellent place to eat! We went without a reservation, and they were full inside but were able to accommodate us on the terrace outside. The food was excellent and came quickly each course, the staff were very friendly and accommodating and it was a lovely experience.”

Google review
“Probably our best meals (we went back!) on our trip to Cyprus. Don't expect lovely harbour views, but do expect generous portions, delicious food, and friendly staff. Meatballs and Kleftiko were amazing.”

Google review
“What makes this restaurant truly unique is its Cypriot meze with an international twist. Instead of a traditional meze alone, it combines the very best of authentic Cypriot favourites with carefully selected international dishes, creating an experience unlike anywhere else.”
